# France

France, officially the French Republic, is a country located primarily in Western Europe.
Its capital and largest city is Paris.

## Geography

Metropolitan France covers an area of 643,801 km², making it the largest country
in the European Union and the third-largest in Europe.

## History

France has been a major power in European and world history. During the 17th and 18th centuries,
France colonised large parts of the Americas; during the 19th and early 20th centuries,
France built one of the largest colonial empires of the time.

## Government

France is a unitary semi-presidential republic with its capital in Paris.
The president is elected by direct popular vote for a five-year term.

## Economy

France has a diversified economy. Tourism is a major industry, with Paris being
the most visited city in the world. France is also known for its wine,
cheese, and fashion industries.
